records.product_name: Satiety Support Weight Management Dry Dog Food
records.ingredients_verbatim: Chicken by-product meal, corn, pea fiber, powdered cellulose, wheat, corn protein meal, wheat gluten, natural flavors, dried plain beet pulp, chicken fat, potassium chloride, marine microalgae oil, vegetable oil, powdered psyllium seed husk, calcium carbonate, choline chloride, vitamins [DL-alpha tocopherol acetate (source of vitamin E), L-ascorbyl-2-polyphosphate (source of vitamin C), niacin supplement, biotin, riboflavin supplement, D-calcium pantothenate, thiamine mononitrate (vitamin B1), pyridoxine hydrochloride (vitamin B6), vitamin B12 supplement, vitamin A acetate, vitamin D3 supplement, folic acid], fructooligosaccharides, sodium tripolyphosphate, rosemary extract, preserved with mixed tocopherols and citric acid, fish oil, glucosamine hydrochloride, DL-methionine, L-lysine, L-carnitine, salt, trace minerals [zinc proteinate, zinc oxide, manganese proteinate, ferrous sulfate, manganous oxide, copper sulfate, sodium selenite, calcium iodate, copper proteinate], marigold extract (Tagetes erecta L.), magnesium oxide, taurine, chondroitin sulfate.
ingredients_ordered_normalized: vitamins [DL-alpha tocopherol acetate (source of vitamin E), L-ascorbyl-2-polyphosphate (source of vitamin C), niacin supplement, biotin, riboflavin supplement, D-calcium pantothenate, thiamine mononitrate (vitamin B1), pyridoxine hydrochloride (vitamin B6), vitamin B12 supplement, vitamin A acetate, vitamin D3 supplement, folic acid]
preserved with mixed tocopherols and citric acid
trace minerals [zinc proteinate, zinc oxide, manganese proteinate, ferrous sulfate, manganous oxide, copper sulfate, sodium selenite, calcium iodate, copper proteinate]
records.formula_source: Current Royal Canin USA Canine Satiety Support Weight Management product page for current formula, GA and calories; PetCareRx and Royal Canin veterinary price list for exact individual UPC-size mapping.
records.barcode_notes: PetCareRx and the Royal Canin veterinary price list map UPC 030111472175 to the 7.7 lb individual bag; the current Royal Canin USA page lists 7.7 lb as an available size.
conflicts: PetCareRx displays an older formula generation. Current Royal Canin USA formula, guaranteed analysis and 2911 kcal/kg / 224 kcal/cup are stored; generations were not combined.
verification_notes: UPC-A check digit verified: weighted 11-digit sum is 55, giving check digit 5.
Exact 7.7 lb individual-unit UPC is supported by PetCareRx and the Royal Canin veterinary price list.
